title: MOFA solemnly refutes false claims regarding the ROC (Taiwan) in China-Oman joint statement
text:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) solemnly refutes the false claims made in a joint statement between the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and the Sultanate of Oman, issued following a meeting between Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Sultan Haitham bin Tariq of Oman on November 2. The statement attempted to undermine Taiwan’s sovereignty, referencing the so-called “one China principle” and misrepresenting United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) Resolution 2758.

MOFA strongly protests and condemns the Chinese government’s continued efforts to mislead the global community and distort international perception through bilateral and multilateral engagement. MOFA also deeply regrets that Oman has aligned with China’s position.

MOFA reiterates the following: The ROC (Taiwan) is a sovereign and independent country; neither the ROC (Taiwan) nor the PRC is subordinate to the other; and the PRC has never governed Taiwan. Taiwan’s sovereignty belongs solely to the people of Taiwan. Moreover, UNGA Resolution 2758 makes no mention of Taiwan, nor does it authorize the PRC to represent Taiwan. No amount of rhetorical manipulation can change these facts.

MOFA once again calls on the world to uphold objectivity, rationality, and independent judgment; acknowledge historical facts and the status quo; and avoid being misled by the Chinese government’s fallacious narratives and political maneuvering.

As a force for good in the international community, Taiwan will steadily bolster cooperation with like-minded countries, staunchly defend national sovereignty, resist authoritarian expansionism, safeguard the values of freedom and democracy, and make ever-greater contributions to the world. (E)
